source_pdf.title: NACA TN 1594, Experimental Investigation of the Effects of Concentrated Weights on Flutter Characteristics of a Straight Cantilever Wing
source_pdf.authors: Harry L. Runyan and John L. Sewall
source_pdf.method: Manual transcription by visually inspecting PyMuPDF rendered pages and targeted crops. Embedded OCR was used only to locate surrounding explanatory text. No simulations, mode matching, or upstream data were used to repair unreadable source digits.

columns: f_h1: natural first bending frequency at zero airspeed
f_h2: natural second bending frequency at zero airspeed
f_t: natural first torsional frequency at zero airspeed
semantics.before_after_interpretation: The report test procedure (PDF page 6 / printed page 5) states natural frequencies were tabulated before and after most runs to determine whether flutter damaged the wing. Row ordering and zero indicated speed distinguish before/after measurements. Absent phase means no corresponding zero-speed observation is printed; it is not a zero frequency.
semantics.dashes: Dash cells denote an unreported quantity. The number of printed dash segments is not counted; normalized transcription is --- .
semantics.gas: All weight-7 test rows have percentage of Freon-12 = 0; the test medium is therefore air. The unweighted run 5 test has 90.8% Freon-12. The source table writes zeros in the surrounding zero-speed flow-condition fields; these are not used to infer additional natural-frequency measurement medium details.
semantics.no_flutter: Printed flutter frequency 0 plus a divergence remark is a no-flutter case, not a 0-Hz natural frequency.
semantics.mode_labels: Mode columns are preserved as actually printed. No relabeling by ordering or by simulation is performed.
semantics.uncertainty: Source-says-Not-clear values remain null. Unusual but legible changes remain as printed. No interpolation supplies missing observations.
